name: ks-payroll
description: Use this skill whenever asked about Kansas payroll withholding for tax year 2026 — Form K-4 employee withholding allowance certificate, KW-3 annual withholding reconciliation (due January 31), KW-5 deposit reports with the five statutory filing frequencies ($200/$1,200/$8,000/$100,000 thresholds), the KDOR rule that any payor who must withhold federal tax from payments to Kansas residents must also withhold Kansas tax, and default withholding when no K-4 is on file. Trigger on "Kansas withholding", "K-4", "KW-3", "KW-5", "KDOR withholding", "Kansas W-2". Corrected 2026-10-28 against archived KDOR FAQ, Pub. KW-100 (full text incl. percentage tables), and KW-3 e-file specs.
